summary.zh: 仓库整理：移除内部工作笔记，公开仓库根目录更干净。
summary.en: Repo hygiene: internal working notes are no longer tracked, keeping the public repository root clean.

highlights.zh: BLOCKED.md 不再纳入 git 管理，改为本地工作文件。
highlights.en: BLOCKED.md is no longer tracked by git; it stays a local working file.

highlights.zh: CLAUDE.md 不再纳入 git 管理，改为本地工作文件。
highlights.en: CLAUDE.md is no longer tracked by git; it stays a local working file.

highlights.zh: PROGRESS.md 不再纳入 git 管理，并新增 .gitignore 规则防止内部笔记（含 .team/）再次被提交。
highlights.en: PROGRESS.md is no longer tracked by git, with .gitignore rules added so internal notes (including .team/) never get committed again.
